description: This PHP source file defines the AccessTokenEntity class implementing the OAuth2 AccessTokenEntityInterface. It manages OAuth access token data such as identifier, expiration, user ID, client, and scopes, and integrates traits for cryptographic and date-time functionality.

classes.name: AccessTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token, encapsulating token data such as identifier, expiry, associated user, client, and scopes. Implements the AccessTokenEntityInterface and uses traits for cryptography, date-time handling, and OAuth-specific functionality.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Method to set a private key, ignored in this implementation as JWT is not used.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the encrypted string representation of the token identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable object indicating token expiration.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date-time, overriding it to be in UTC and adding the token TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with the token.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the user identifier associated with the token.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the token.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the client entity associated with the token.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope entity to the token.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Retrieves all scope entities associated with the token.
